title: ECR ionization / pre-ionization source evidence matrix (N2, O, O2, air, Xe)
scope: Evidence audit only. No model implementation, no architecture conclusion, no ranking of ECR against RF or any other ionization technology. ABEP chamber conditions are TBD from the upstream ICD (intake -> filter -> compressor -> atmospheric gas chamber -> valve).

evidence_classes.measured: reported measurement (or flight/hardware specification as reported)
evidence_classes.inferred: ratio/estimate derived from reported values (by the source or by this audit)
evidence_classes.reconstructed: measurement passed through the source's own correction/integration model
evidence_classes.model-derived: computed from a physical formula/model (source's or this audit's)
evidence_classes.assumed: assumption, target or claim without direct validating evidence

regime_match_rubric.yes: unit identities/conversion constants valid regardless of ABEP design
regime_match_rubric.partial: at least one of gas, power class, frequency class or device type matches the RFP envelope; others differ or are unknown
regime_match_rubric.no: clear mismatch (gas outside scope, power/frequency far outside, or unrelated quantity)
regime_match_rubric.TBD: depends on ABEP quantities not yet fixed (ICD chamber density/pressure/composition, ECR frequency, magnetic-circuit design)
